texts.facts: 2. The sequence of events of this case has been that on 03.08.2006 at about 2.30 a.m. Shruti Sharma sustained burns all over her body while she was sleeping at her matrimonial home. The information was recorded at PS at about 3.10 a.m. vide DD No. 3 at P.P. Jharoda, P.S. Timar Pur. The PCR was called and injured Shruti was taken to LNJP hospital where her entry is recorded at 3.45 a.m. Initially, she was found fit for the statement at about 4.45 a.m. but thereafter she became unfit for making any kind of statement. The SDM visited the hospital at 6.25 a.m. and also at 10.20 State vs Anand Sharma Etc. on 28 May, 2012 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/36502967/ 1 a.m. on 03.08.2006 but found her unfit for statement. Shruti Sharma was shifted to Apollo hospital by her parents for better treatment and at Apollo hospital she was found fit for statement at 4.00 p.m. The SDM reached Apollo hospital and recorded statement (dying declaration) of Shruti Sharma, wherein she named her husband and inlaws for causing cruelty to her and for burning her by pouring kerosene oil. On the basis of this statement, rukka was sent at about 5.20 p.m. and FIR was registered at PS Timar Pur. The crime team inspected the spot of occurrence and exhibits were lifted from the spot by the police. Initially the FIR was registered u/s 498A and 307 IPC. The husband Anand Sharma and fatherinlaw Om Prakash were arrested on 03.08.2006 itself, whereas sisterinlaw and motherinlaw were arrested on 08.08.2006. S.C.No. 57/10 Page 2 of 54 pages State Vs Anand Sharma etc. On 16.08.2006 Shruti Sharma succumbed to the injuries at Apollo hospital and thereafter the case was converted u/s 304B IPC. The inquest proceedings were conducted by the SDM and investigating officer and postmortem on the dead body was got conducted. On completion of investigation, the charge sheet was submitted against all the accused. 3. The case was committed to the court of sessions since the offence u/s 304B IPC is exclusively triable by the court of sessions. 4. On 09.07.2007, all the accused were charged for having committed offences punishable u/s 498 A IPC read with section 34 IPC and u/s 304B IPC read with section 34 IPC to which they pleaded not guilty and claimed to be tried. 5. During the trial, sisterinlaw accused Geeta expired and hence proceedings were abated against her vide order dated 27.03.2010. 6. Prosecution examined 29 witnesses in all to bring home the guilt of the accused. The substance of prosecution evidence is as follows : 7. PW1 Manju Sharma, is the mother of deceased Shruti Sharma. She stated that marriage between Shruti and Anand Sharma was solemnized on 29.01.2003. At the time of marriage, maruti car was given on the asking of fatherinlaw Om Prakash. After the marriage, Shruti was asked to bring cash and gifts from her parents and on every festival, accused persons used to handover a list of articles required by them. Shruti was harassed and beaten up by the accused and her needs and requirements were not fulfilled by them. In July/August, 2004, accused Anand visited and demanded Rs. 50,000/ S.C.No. 57/10 Page 3 of 54 pages State Vs Anand Sharma etc. with a promise to repay the same. The amount of Rs. 50,000/ was paid but it was never returned by him. After some time, accused Anand again demanded Rs. 2 lacs for purchasing a tempo and when the said amount was not paid to him, all the accused persons started harassing Shruti more. Even during pregnancy, Shruti was not given proper food and care and no State vs Anand Sharma Etc. on 28 May, 2012 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/36502967/ 2 money was spent by accused on her medical. On 17.03.2004, Shruti gave birth to a daughter due to which accused persons got annoyed and ill treated and cursed her particularly motherinlaw. In August 2004, after the retirement of Shruti's father, accused Om Prakash with other accused pressurized Shruti to bring share from the property of her parents. On refusal, she was badly beaten up and turned out of the house at midnight and was asked to commit suicide. Shruti reached to her parent's house in the midnight and narrated the facts. She remained with her parents for 56 months and only after accused Anand apologized that Shruti was sent back. The witness further stated that on 02.08.2006 at about 8/8.30 p.m., she talked to Shruti on telephone and Shruti told her that She was being tortured by the accused persons and they could do anything to her. Shruti even felt danger to her life and asked her mother to take her to Gurgaon. In the early morning of 03.08.2006 at about 4/4.30 a.m. telephone call was received from accused Om Prakash and it was informed that Shruti was admitted in hospital in burnt condition. They rushed to the hospital and found Shruti lying unconscious on a bed in corridor with burns all over her body except S.C.No. 57/10 Page 4 of 54 pages State Vs Anand Sharma etc. her soles, hands, face and hair. Since, treatment was not properly given to Shruti, they shifted her to Apollo hospital where she remained for 14 days. SDM recorded the statement of Shruti in the evening and only thereafter PW 1 could talk to her daughter. Shruti told her that all the accused persons had caught and by pouring kerosene oil had burnt her. Shruti never recovered and was declared dead on 16.08.2006. The statement of this witness was recorded during the investigation. 8. During crossexamination on behalf of accused persons, witness stated that at the time of stay of Shruti with them for about six months, no application was moved anywhere for taking the custody of Shruti's daughter. She denied the suggestion that Shruti had stayed only for one month because of illness of her mother and Shruti's daughter was also with her. The witness admitted that her statement was not recorded by the police or the SDM on the day statement of Shruti was recorded. PW1 admitted that her statement was recorded on 21.09.2006 but denied that she leveled false allegations against the accused. The witness was further crossexamined at length, wherein her testimony was sought to be confronted with her statement recorded u/s 161 Cr. P.C. on various aspects. The witness denied the suggestions that Shruti was treated well by the accused persons and therefore no complaint was lodged anywhere during the life time of Shruti. She denied that accused persons never demanded anything before or after the marriage or even during the marriage period or that no money was ever given to the accused. It is denied that S.C.No. 57/10 Page 5 of 54 pages State Vs Anand Sharma etc. accused never demanded any money from Shruti or her parents or that she resided happily with her husband and was taken care of properly. The witness further denied that statement of Shruti recorded by SDM is manipulated or that incident was merely an accident. During further crossexamination, PW1 stated that police did not meet her between 03.08.2006 to 17.08.2006. She was allowed to meet Shruti only once during this period that too in ICU. Police met this witness for the first time on 21.09.2006 when she was taken to some place for giving statement. She stated that she has given a typed statement which was typed in the house by the family members (no typed statement was found on the record). She had stated to the police about the payment of Rs. 50,000/ and failure of accused Anand to repay the same and on this aspect she was confronted with her statement u/s 161 Cr. P.C. She denied that Shruti was never harassed in connection with State vs Anand Sharma Etc. on 28 May, 2012 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/36502967/ 3 dowry demands or that incident was merely an accident. 9. PW2 Yogesh Pratap, SDM Civil Lines, Delhi, deposed that on 03.08.2006 he received a call from ASI Om Pal about this case. He reached LNJP hospital at 6.20 a.m. but found that the lady admitted with burn injuries was unfit for statement. The extent of burns sustained by the lady was 80% and kerosene smell was coming. SDM instructed ASI Om Pal to send crime team to the spot. The witness again reached the hospital at about 10.00 a.m. but this time also the patient was unconscious and her statement could not be recorded. S.C.No. 57/10 Page 6 of 54 pages State Vs Anand Sharma etc. On the same day, at about 3.00 p.m. PW2 again received telephone call from ASI OM Pal that patient has been shifted to Apollo hospital. He reached at Apollo hospital at about 4.15 p.m. and inquired from the doctor on duty, who certified that patient was fit for statement vide endorsement on MLC EX PW2/A. SDM went inside and talked to the patient and satisfied himself about the fitness of the lady to make the statement. PW2 then proceeded to record her statement vide EX PW2/B and obtained her thumb impression and signatures on the same. He handed over the copy of statement to investigating officer for appropriate legal action. On 17.08.2006, the information about death of victim was received and the witness conducted inquest proceedings vide EX PW 2/C and D. The body was sent for postmortem and thereafter handed over to her relatives. During crossexamination, witness stated that on his first visit to the hospital, he talked to the doctor about the history of patient but he was only told that smell of kerosene oil was present. It is admitted that on statement EX PW2/B, the signatures of any doctor were not taken since the witness alone was present with the victim while recording the statement. The certificate of the doctor was obtained on MLC. No oxygen mask was put on Shruti. The witness formally talked to Shruti before recording her statement, although did not reproduce the contents of formal talks in the statement. He left the hospital at 5.00 p.m. The witness denied the suggestion that he made endorsement at pointsA and B on MLC EX PW2/A belatedly or that he is deposing falsely about his visit to S.C.No. 57/10 Page 7 of 54 pages State Vs Anand Sharma etc. Apollo hospital. He denied the suggestion that no such statement was made by the victim or that he has fabricated the same at the instance of relatives. During further crossexamination, witness admitted that he had not seen the treatment chart of patient on reaching the hospital and therefore could not tell if Pethedene was administered to the patient. He denied to be deposing falsely or that no dying declaration was recorded by him. 10. PW3 Dr. Nitin, posted as CMO LNJP Hospital on 03.08.2006 proved the MLC of Shruti Sharma vide EX PW3/A counter signed by the witness. The MLC was prepared by Dr. Deepak, junior resident. 11. The injuries were ante mortem in nature involving 70% of body surface area. He proved his detailed report EX PW4/A. 12. PW5 Jayant Sharma, is the brother of the deceased. He supported the prosecution case to the effect that car was demanded at the time of marriage. He denied that Shruti was never harassed in connection with dowry or anything else or that Shruti died only because of an accident.
